title: Bob says hold off, then the party says yes: after the offers went out Bob writes "Hold off on this one for now"; a day later the party accepts Wednesday the 9th at 10. Resuming is his: record the yes, tell Bob, book nothing, mail nothing.
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). Event 0 is Bob's line alone (nothing happened, so it has no capture); the Wednesday 10:30 pattern row is dropped so offer 842 is free.

review.question: You say hold off; a day later Odette says yes to Wednesday 10. Expectation at the hold-off: wait, nothing to Odette. At her yes: tell you, nothing booked, nothing mailed. Agree with both?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes the week of
December 7 for introductions? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Dec 8, 11:15am to 11:45am ET
- Wed, Dec 9, 10:00am to 10:30am ET
- Thu, Dec 10, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Bob wrote about this plan on Telegram.

bob.text: Hold off on this one for now, I'll come back to it.

bobDecides.what: whether anything goes to Odette while the plan is on hold

expect.basis: Bob's line puts the plan on hold; nothing has come in, and the proposal is already in Odette's hands. The loop prompt: "Ask Bob only for a decision that is his"; whether Odette hears anything while it is on hold is his, so she waits (or acknowledges, or asks him whether to tell Odette).
expect.notes: alsoAccept ask_bob: an acknowledgement to Bob, or a question whether to tell Odette, is as good as waiting (the brief's "tell_bob" is the ask_bob class; A0 may answer with tell_bob, its firstStep). The miss is any mail to Odette (V6 by bobDecides: an ask, a propose or a booking).

events.trigger: Odette Brandt replied on the thread.

thread.text: Wednesday the 9th at 10 works for me, see you then.

bobDecides.what: resuming the plan after Bob said hold off

expect.basis: Odette's words are a yes to offered slot 842 (the accept rule: record_yes it). Bob put the plan on hold the day before, so resuming it (booking, or mailing her) is his: "Ask Bob only for a decision that is his." She records the yes and tells him, booking nothing.
expect.notes: FOR BOB: wait (leaving the yes unanswered) is not accepted. Odette has a yes on the table that Bob does not know about, and "Nothing runs on this plan later unless someone writes or a follow-up is set": with nobody told, the yes sits until he happens to come back. The hold is on acting, not on telling him. A booking is V6 (and the class miss); a confirmation mail to Odette likewise.
